name: spectra-council
title: Spectra Council
description: Ask one AI for a review and you get one opinion, delivered with full confidence. Spectra Council seats several, each on a profile of yours with the model and effort you choose: Claude, Codex, a local model. Each reviews a repository, a folder or a document on its own and reports findings with evidence; then, round by round, they back or challenge each other's. Every finding ends agreed, confirmed, disputed or withdrawn, and dissent stays on the record as a minority report. You accept, dismiss or defer each one; the agent or a fixer profile fixes the accepted ones, or files them as beads issues, and the reviewers re-check the fixes. A research council researches a question on the web instead: each seat checks the others' sources, the claims are argued out the same way, and one editor writes one sourced answer, with every claim's status and dissent kept.
tagline: Several models review your code or documents, or research a question, then argue out each finding.

profileSettings.label: Spectra Council fixer
profileSettings.hint: Whose agent fixes a review's accepted findings: another profile (say, pi with a different model) in a conversation of its own. None: this conversation's agent.

profileSettings.label: Spectra Council turn limit
profileSettings.hint: How long each turn of a review may take before it gives up: a reviewer's review, the grouping, each round, the proposals and each re-check. A review cut short can still be fetched in once its late reply comes; any other turn cut short just fails.
